# Workforce Planning Management (WPM)

> An open-source, spec-driven, all-in-one HR platform demo: hiring to retirement,
> in Rust (Loco, Axum, SeaORM, PostgreSQL) and SvelteKit (Svelte 5 runes), in 17
> locales. **Demo software — not a production HR or payroll system; synthetic
> data only.** WPM owns the employment relationship and references identities
> (person, worker, organization, course services) by EntityRef URN.

Start with the specification: it is the single source of truth, and no code
lands without it. A change is a requirement (WPM-R*), a design decision
(WPM-D*), a task (WPM-T*), code and tests.

Status as of 2026-10-30: tasks WPM-T1–T399 (done, open and part done counted in spec/implementation-status.md); requirements up to WPM-R217; decisions up to WPM-D150; 114 migrations, 86 controllers, 57 pages. Counts come from [spec/implementation-status.md](spec/implementation-status.md); they count what is declared, not what passes.

## Specification

- [spec/index.md](spec/index.md): overview, topic map, status
- [spec/tasks.md](spec/tasks.md): the live delivery checklist (WPM-T1–T398); each entry records what was verified and what was not; Phase 25 is the newest
- [spec/requirements.md](spec/requirements.md): requirements (WPM-R1–R38 here; R39–R216 in the topic files, each pointed at from the end of this file)
- [spec/design.md](spec/design.md): design decisions (WPM-D1–D28 here; D29–D149 in the topic files, each range pointed at from this file)
- [spec/domain-model.md](spec/domain-model.md): entities
- [spec/auth.md](spec/auth.md): personas, ABAC, masking, the sensitivity map, the activation runbook
- [spec/audit.md](spec/audit.md): what is audited, and the rule that a write without its audit row does not happen (WPM-D107)
- [spec/expense-claims.md](spec/expense-claims.md): expense claims with approval by someone other than the claimant (WPM-R55)
- [spec/job-levels.md](spec/job-levels.md): Google technical job levels L3–L11, a worker's level, a role's level and pay band (WPM-R52–R53)
- [spec/sfia.md](spec/sfia.md): proposed SFIA and SFIAplus support, imported from the deployer's licensed download, never shipped (WPM-R109–R113)
- [spec/worker-unions.md](spec/worker-unions.md): research and proposal for recognised bodies, collective agreements, consultation obligations and aggregate information, never individual union membership (WPM-R102–R108)
- [spec/equality-impact/template.md](spec/equality-impact/template.md): equality impact template for any scoring (WPM-R99–R101)
- [spec/equality-impact/register.md](spec/equality-impact/register.md): scoring register and draft equality impact assessments for each score WPM has today
- [spec/ppm-issues-and-changes.md](spec/ppm-issues-and-changes.md): proposed issues register (FR-14) and change requests for project-portfolio-management, with the people-impact answer from WPM (WPM-R95–R97)
- [spec/operations-and-governance.md](spec/operations-and-governance.md): backup and restore, deployment, upgrade, runbook, information governance pack, retention per record kind, Entra ID sign-in, every page in every locale (WPM-R89–R94)
- [spec/production-readiness.md](spec/production-readiness.md): sign-in on by default, security headers, rate limiting, standalone build and CI, license texts, releases, generated status (WPM-R72–R74, R77, R78, R87, R88)
- [spec/implementation-status.md](spec/implementation-status.md): generated counts of migrations, controllers, declared tests, locales and tasks (scripts/status.py)
- [spec/self-service-and-worker-requests.md](spec/self-service-and-worker-requests.md): proposed self-service updates, equality monitoring and workplace health requirements (both bounded, off by default), flexible working, resignations, my time-off (WPM-R124–R130)
- [spec/locales-x-for-roles/index.md](spec/locales-x-for-roles/index.md): a page for each role per locale in locales/en-gb-oxendict/for/ (WPM-R131, D79)
- [spec/readiness-assessment.md](spec/readiness-assessment.md): readiness for large medical and governmental organizations: verdict, blocker, gaps with evidence, human gates (WPM-R114–R123)
- [spec/engagements.md](spec/engagements.md): the end date by engagement basis, extensions, a contractor's supplier, route and masked rate, status assessments (WPM-R79, R80)
- [spec/delivery-capacity.md](spec/delivery-capacity.md): skill pools, programme demand, partner commitments, the capacity view, the constraint pool, the start check and start decisions (WPM-R56–R60)
- [spec/pay-scales.md](spec/pay-scales.md): A national public-sector pay scale, salary placement and progression lookup, a worker's band and step (WPM-R51, R54)
- [spec/people-directory-and-cover.md](spec/people-directory-and-cover.md): directory, emergency contacts, backups, the on-call rota (WPM-R39–R42)
- [spec/skills-and-training.md](spec/skills-and-training.md): skills gap analysis, training time (WPM-R43–R44)
- [spec/joiners-and-leavers.md](spec/joiners-and-leavers.md): dated checklists, last-day handover (WPM-R45–R46)
- [spec/communication-and-leadership.md](spec/communication-and-leadership.md): announcements, the CEO dashboard, insights (WPM-R47–R49)
- [spec/locales-for-global-sharing-with-svelte/index.md](spec/locales-for-global-sharing-with-svelte/index.md): locales; "How WPM applies this" (WPM-R50)
- [spec/strategic-workforce-planning.md](spec/strategic-workforce-planning.md): plans, forecast, gap analysis (WPM-R34–R38)

- [spec/github-pages-site.md](spec/github-pages-site.md): The static documentation site: what it shows, the locale switcher, dates in the page's locale, the subtree export; built, not published (WPM-R217, WPM-D150, WPM-T392, WPM-T399)
- [spec/cross-app-bridges.md](spec/cross-app-bridges.md): bridges to CRM and PPM: the family contract (2026-10-30), references and counts only, the caller's token (WPM-R206 to R213)
- [spec/mhra.md](spec/mhra.md): the MHRA as a named UK regulator; its workforce questions left open until its guidance is read (WPM-R212)
- [spec/regulatory.md](spec/regulatory.md): regulatory position: demo software, not a production HR or payroll system
- [spec/roadmap.md](spec/roadmap.md): what is beyond the task queue: decisions, dependencies and follow-ups
- [spec/testing.md](spec/testing.md): how to run each suite, the PostgreSQL and Podman setup
- [spec/tolerances.md](spec/tolerances.md): WPM-R140 and WPM-D93: tolerances on a workforce plan in time, cost, resources and risk, red, amber or green, an unknown is never green
- [spec/pay-transparency.md](spec/pay-transparency.md): WPM-R144–R146 and WPM-D99: the EU Pay Transparency Directive: seven pay gap indicators with a floor, pay information for the worker and none asked of the candidate, the joint pay assessment trigger, and what the spec round checked
- [spec/human-capital-reporting.md](spec/human-capital-reporting.md): WPM-R147 and WPM-D100: a dated read-only report mapped to ISO 30414:2025 and the revised ESRS S1 requirement numbers, a mapping and never a copy
- [spec/staff-records-and-pay.md](spec/staff-records-and-pay.md): Proposed WPM-R161–R178, WPM-D112–D120: the electronic staff record, assignments and coding, annual service, the person-centric record, statutory and mandatory learning, the PADR, payroll information, deductions, pensions and student loans
- [spec/absence-and-line-managers.md](spec/absence-and-line-managers.md): Proposed WPM-R179–R189, WPM-D121–D124: sickness absence without reasons, return-to-work, review points, occupational health, stress assessed in the work, and the manager's action list
- [spec/disability-and-adjustments.md](spec/disability-and-adjustments.md): Proposed WPM-R190–R196, WPM-D125–D127: an adjustments passport the person owns, working with me, absence rules that adjust, candidate adjustments, disability measures from monitoring only
- [spec/succession-deputies-and-acting-up.md](spec/succession-deputies-and-acting-up.md): Proposed WPM-R197–R205, WPM-D128–D133: succession on positions with evidence beside readiness, deputies with scoped authority, acting up with its pay, limits and fairness
- [spec/positions.md](spec/positions.md): WPM-R152, WPM-R153 and WPM-D104: positions as budgeted seats, vacancy and over-establishment, and the current-versus-target organization diff
- [spec/worker-matching.md](spec/worker-matching.md): WPM-R134 and WPM-D85: matching worker records, unknown is never zero, a score proposes and never merges

- [workforce-planning-management-ui-with-svelte/index.md](workforce-planning-management-ui-with-svelte/index.md): the browser client; strings in `content/locales/<locale>/ui.json`; money, numbers and dates through the page's locale
- [workforce-planning-management-matcher-with-rust/README.md](workforce-planning-management-matcher-with-rust/README.md): the worker matcher crate (published; the service uses the crates.io copy): pure, explainable matching of worker records; no national identifiers (WPM-R134)
- [workforce-planning-management-service-with-rust/spec/index.md](workforce-planning-management-service-with-rust/spec/index.md): the service's stack-specific spec: layout, environment variables, masking and privacy mechanics
- [workforce-planning-management-ui-with-svelte/spec/index.md](workforce-planning-management-ui-with-svelte/spec/index.md): the UI's stack-specific spec
- [workforce-planning-management.github.io/README.md](workforce-planning-management.github.io/README.md): The GitHub Pages documentation site: SvelteKit adapter-static, Lily pickers, 258 prerendered pages; the publish steps (make github-pages) for the owner

## Operate

- [index.md](index.md): The documentation index: the way in to the documents, and the site's home page
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): build, run and test both subprojects, the demo, the scheduled tasks (`config/scheduler.yaml`), translations, containers
- [README.md](README.md): what WPM is, its status and subprojects, and where the documentation is
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability, and what to read before exposing either subproject
- [docs/tutorials/family-bridges.md](docs/tutorials/family-bridges.md): tutorial: the bridges to PPM and CRM with curl (pool link, peer demand and supply, people impact, the hire webhook, the overlap check, the lean worker list)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): ground rules and how to contribute; the gates a change must pass
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): repo-level change summary; each subproject's CHANGELOG.md is the detailed history
- [NEWS.md](NEWS.md): milestones

## Conventions an agent must keep

- Pure, DB-free, clock-free rules first; controllers only wire them.
- An unknown is never a zero; roll-ups return counts and name no one; a view that cannot answer says so.
- What must not be stored gets no column; what must not be disclosed gets no endpoint.
- A new table holding personal data joins the subject-access export, the erasure statements and (if soft-deleting) the retention sweep list.
- Internal links in the UI use `l("/path")` so the locale prefix is kept; every new UI string goes in every `-001` locale and `pnpm cms-config` is rerun.
- Podman, not Docker; PostgreSQL, not SQLite.
